# identity API

Accounts, users, roles, sessions, API tokens and personal access tokens.

Base path `/api/v1/identity` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/identity.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/identity.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

#### POST /api/v1/identity/accounts/{account_id}/api-tokens/purge-revoked

**Purge Revoked Tokens**

Delete every revoked API token of the account for good; active tokens stay. Each one is audited (`api_token.purged`); the audit history of the tokens stays.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [ApiTokensPurgedOut](#apitokenspurgedout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/identity/accounts/{account_id}/api-tokens/{token_id}

**Revoke Token**

Revoke an API token; with `purge=true` delete an already revoked one for good.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `token_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `purge` | query | boolean | no | Delete the revoked token for good instead of revoking it; 409 while the token is not revoked; default `false` |

| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### identity: demo

#### POST /api/v1/identity/demo/session

**Demo Session**

"Try the demo": a session of the prepared demo user without credentials (the same tokens and cookie as `POST /session`). 404 outside demo mode and while the demo is not seeded; rate limited per address.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Mowdeck-Refresh` | header | string or null | no | `cookie-only`: the refresh token is only set as the HttpOnly cookie and `refresh_token` in the body is null (browsers). Without it the body carries it too. |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [TokenOut](#tokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

### identity: login providers

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me/external-identities

**My External Identities**

The caller's linked accounts of login providers.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [ExternalIdentityOut](#externalidentityout) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/identity/me/external-identities/{provider}

**Unlink External Identity**

Remove the caller's link to a login provider (the password stays). Step-up: a stolen session must not be able to strip the owner's ways in unnoticed.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/me/external-identities/{provider}/link

**Link External Identity**

Start linking an account of a login provider to the caller: the current password again (the login limits apply) or, without it, a recent step-up confirmation, then the provider's authorization URL and the binding cookie. 409 when an account of this provider is already linked.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [ExternalLinkIn](#externallinkin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [OAuthStartOut](#oauthstartout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/oauth/{provider}/callback

**Oauth Callback**

The provider sends the browser back here: finish the sign-in (refresh cookie as after a password login) or the link, then redirect to the web app (303).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string | yes |  |
| `mowdeck_oauth` | cookie | string or null | no |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 303 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/oauth/{provider}/start

**Oauth Start**

Start signing in with a login provider (404 when it is not enabled): its authorization URL, and a cookie that binds the round trip to this browser.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | path | string | yes |  |

**Request body**: `application/json` [OAuthStartIn](#oauthstartin) or null

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [OAuthStartOut](#oauthstartout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/app-login/code

**App Login Code**

Native app hand-off (ADR 0050), browser side: exchange the caller's fresh login session (any login method, at most a few minutes old) for a one-time code bound to the app's sign-in request and its PKCE challenge (403 for an unknown, used or expired request). The browser session ends; the page sends the code to the app's URL scheme.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [AppCodeIn](#appcodein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AppCodeOut](#appcodeout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/app-login/session

**App Login Session**

Native app hand-off, app side: the one-time code and the PKCE verifier give the app a normal session (the same tokens and cookie as `POST /session`). The code is single use.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Mowdeck-Refresh` | header | string or null | no | `cookie-only`: the refresh token is only set as the HttpOnly cookie and `refresh_token` in the body is null (browsers). Without it the body carries it too. |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [AppSessionIn](#appsessionin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [TokenOut](#tokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/app-login/start

**App Login Start**

Native app hand-off (ADR 0050), first step in the app: register the S256 hash of the PKCE verifier; the sign-in page in the system browser gets only the request id.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [AppLoginStartIn](#apploginstartin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [AppLoginStartOut](#apploginstartout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me

**Me**

The caller: claims of the current token, user data and memberships.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MeOut](#meout) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me/api-tokens

**List Personal Tokens**

The caller's personal access tokens (ADR 0064), newest first, without secrets. Users only: an API token gets 403, so a token never sees or manages tokens.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [PersonalTokenOut](#personaltokenout) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/me/api-tokens

**Create Personal Token**

Create a personal access token for your own scripts: curated scopes, an expiry of at most 365 days, at most 25 active per user. Needs a recent step-up (ADR 0057): without it 401 `reauth-required`; API tokens get 403. The secret is in the response once.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PersonalTokenIn](#personaltokenin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [PersonalTokenOut](#personaltokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/identity/me/api-tokens/{token_id}

**Revoke Personal Token**

Revoke one of your personal access tokens at once (404 for any other token).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me/onboarding

**My Onboarding**

The caller's progress through the setup tour of the web app (ADR 0062): status, skipped steps and dismissed hints. `new` (nothing stored) for a user who never saw the tour. Only users; API tokens get 403.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [OnboardingOut](#onboardingout) |

#### PUT /api/v1/identity/me/onboarding

**Save Onboarding**

Replace the caller's tour progress (status, skipped steps, dismissed hints). The keys are the web app's (`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$`, at most 32 each, duplicates dropped).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [OnboardingIn](#onboardingin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [OnboardingOut](#onboardingout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### PUT /api/v1/identity/me/password

**Change Password**

Change the own password; the other sessions end.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PasswordChangeIn](#passwordchangein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/me/permissions

**My Permissions**

Batch of "may I?" questions for rendering the UI (answers are not cached here).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [PermissionsIn](#permissionsin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of boolean |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me/platform

**My Platform**

Whether the caller is an operator admin; 200 for every authenticated principal.

Lets the web app decide about the operator console without probing a 403 endpoint. The check goes through the authorizer and its cache.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [MePlatformOut](#meplatformout) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/me/widget-credentials

**List Widget Credentials**

The caller's iOS widget credentials (ADR 0059), newest first, without secrets.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [WidgetCredentialOut](#widgetcredentialout) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/me/widget-credentials

**Create Widget Credential**

Create the credential the iOS widgets and the Live Activity use instead of the app's session: an API token limited to `mower.view` and `mower.control` on the account (as far as the caller holds them), valid for 90 days, revocable here and in the token list. The secret is in the response once. Only users (not API tokens) can call it.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [WidgetCredentialIn](#widgetcredentialin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [WidgetCredentialOut](#widgetcredentialout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### DELETE /api/v1/identity/me/widget-credentials/{token_id}

**Revoke Widget Credential**

Revoke one of the caller's widget credentials (404 for any other token).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token_id` | path | string (uuid) | yes |  |

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/register

**Register**

Create an account; the registering user becomes its owner.

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [RegisterIn](#registerin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Successful Response | `application/json` [RegisteredOut](#registeredout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/session

**Login**

Log in with username and password: access token, refresh token (cookie, and the body unless `X-Mowdeck-Refresh: cookie-only`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Mowdeck-Refresh` | header | string or null | no | `cookie-only`: the refresh token is only set as the HttpOnly cookie and `refresh_token` in the body is null (browsers). Without it the body carries it too. |

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [LoginIn](#loginin)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [TokenOut](#tokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/session/logout

**Logout**

End the login session of the refresh token.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Requested-With` | header | string or null | no |  |
| `mowdeck_refresh` | cookie | string or null | no |  |

**Request body**: `application/json` [RefreshIn](#refreshin) or null

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/session/logout-all

**Logout All**

End every session of the calling user.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 204 | Successful Response | no body |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/session/refresh

**Refresh**

Rotate the refresh token; a reused token ends the whole login session (except within the short grace after a lost response).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Requested-With` | header | string or null | no |  |
| `X-Mowdeck-Refresh` | header | string or null | no | `cookie-only`: the refresh token is only set as the HttpOnly cookie and `refresh_token` in the body is null (browsers). Without it the body carries it too. |
| `mowdeck_refresh` | cookie | string or null | no |  |

**Request body**: `application/json` [RefreshIn](#refreshin) or null

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [TokenOut](#tokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### POST /api/v1/identity/token

**Exchange**

Exchange an API token for a 10 minute access token (`kind=api_token`).

**Request body** (required): `application/json` [TokenExchangeIn](#tokenexchangein)

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [TokenOut](#tokenout) |
| 422 | Validation Error | `application/json` [HTTPValidationError](#httpvalidationerror) |

#### GET /api/v1/identity/ui-areas

**Ui Areas**

Areas of the web app shell that the deployed modules announce and the caller may open.

Merged from the module descriptors Identity polls (`MOWDECK_IDENTITY_MODULE_URLS`) and its own; an area is listed when its `required_permission` is among the caller's permissions.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` array of [UiAreaOut](#uiareaout) |
